description: Exact transcription of the Ikenoyama column in Tang et al., Table II; no normalization or element conversion performed.
source_title: Muon Simulations for Super-Kamiokande, KamLAND and CHOOZ
source_authors: Alfred Tang, Glenn Horton-Smith, Vitaly A. Kudryavtsev, Alessandra Tonazzo
source_table: Table II, PDF page 32 (printed page 32); density and mean atomic quantities in section II.C
source_caption_wording: Chemical composition of the Ikenoyama and Ardennes rock in elemental percentage.
percentage_basis_note: The source caption says elemental percentage but its table rows list compounds. Interpreting these numbers as compound mass percentages for a material mixture is an interpretation, not an explicit mass-fraction label in the table. Do not interpret the separate prose statement of 2.2 percent hydrogen as a mass fraction.
audit_use: Finite-material sensitivity model only; not a survey-exact SK material correction. Normalize the raw compound weights and convert them to element mass fractions on an authorized CPU worker if implementing the mass-mixture interpretation.
